---
title: "Providers"
description: "Connect Positron to a language model provider and manage your provider settings."
---

To connect a language model provider, run the command _Posit Assistant: Configure AI Providers_ or select **Configure Language Model Providers** from the {{< fa circle-user >}} **Accounts** menu, then select **Connect** next to the provider.

For what each provider needs and how to sign in, see [Providers](https://assistant.posit.co/docs/getting-started/providers/) in the Posit Assistant documentation.

Don't see your provider? Add a [custom provider](https://assistant.posit.co/docs/getting-started/providers/#custom-providers). It can use any of the provider types above, so you can connect a company gateway, a second account on the same provider, or a local model server.

## `providers.json` {#provider-configuration-file}

Posit Assistant saves your provider settings, but not your keys or tokens, to `~/.posit/ai/providers.json`. To change something the **AI Providers** screen does not cover, such as turning a provider off, sending custom HTTP headers, or filtering the model list, run _Open AI Provider Settings (JSON)_. For every key the file accepts, see the [`providers.json` reference](https://assistant.posit.co/docs/reference/providers-config/).

::: {.callout-note}
Positron 2026.10 removed the `authentication.*`, `positron.assistant.provider.*`, and `positron.assistant.models.overrides.*` settings. If they are still in your `settings.json`, Positron moves them to `providers.json` on startup. To run this again, use _Migrate AI Provider Settings to providers.json_.
:::
